value.rationale: Exponent two is the first natural nonlinear integer power in the published two-urn problem. Its exact algebraic transition constant and complete 9→5→3 equilibrium census provide a sharp closed-form benchmark for stochastic simulations and bifurcation analysis, including the merging of four off-anti-diagonal equilibria at the probabilistic domination boundary. Neither a routine model substitution nor an arbitrary finite table.
